title: Rectifiability of the straight visible boundary and the limits of segment-based Hardy criteria
summary: Weighted Hardy inequalities on a domain $Ω\subset\R^n$ can be deduced from lower Hausdorff-content bounds on suitable visible parts of the boundary, and it is natural to look for visible sets described by straight segments, which are easier to verify than the curve-based visual boundary of Koskela and Lehrbäck. We show that this approach is subject to an intrinsic obstruction.
